name: Curiosity as a predictor of health and fitness app usage
fact: Curiosity is one of the strongest predictors of sustained health and fitness app usage.

provenance.title: Intrinsic motivations in health and fitness app engagement: A mediation model of entertainment
provenance.quote_or_locus: The findings reveal that entertainment mediates the relationship between intrinsic motivations and continuance intention, with challenge and curiosity being the strongest predictors of sustained app usage
